project: KiCad AI Workflow — Project Management Framework
problem_statement: Agents skip verification, repeat known mistakes, lose context, and claim false success. Human review loop bottlenecked by scattered CLI/file information. Need hardened stage-gate runner with evidence enforcement + NiceGUI review dashboard.
approaches_shortlisted: Hardened Harness — take existing process_runner.py, make gates inescapable
Evidence Ledger — append-only proof chain with file hashes
NiceGUI Review Dashboard — three-panel layout for human review
recommendation: Unified Stage-Gate Runner + Evidence-First Dashboard, built in parallel sharing Pydantic evidence model. Custom runner borrowing patterns from Dagster (blocking checks), CrewAI (guardrail retry), Prefect (typed human input), GLEAN (evidence accumulation).

sessions.summary: Full problem-solving session: interrogated requirements, brainstormed 6 approaches, researched PCB design landscape + agent frameworks + dashboard frameworks, recommended hardened runner + NiceGUI dashboard, discussed sequencing (parallel), created detailed implementation plan with evidence model schema, ~47 tests, 3-phase delivery.
